name: Bench: Unbind_ALR_Hotkeys removes the two template key bindings

operation.value:
Dim d As Document, baseline As Long, bound As Long, unbound As Long, qqc As Long, rjc As Long, foundAfterBind As Long, foundAfterUnbind As Long, kb As KeyBinding
Set d = ActiveDocument
Application.CustomizationContext = d.AttachedTemplate
qqc = BuildKeyCode(wdKeyControl, wdKeyShift, wdKeyQ)
rjc = BuildKeyCode(wdKeyControl, wdKeyShift, wdKeyX)
baseline = Application.KeyBindings.Count
Application.Run "Bind_ALR_Hotkeys"
Application.CustomizationContext = d.AttachedTemplate
bound = Application.KeyBindings.Count
For Each kb In Application.KeyBindings
If kb.KeyCode = qqc Or kb.KeyCode = rjc Then foundAfterBind = foundAfterBind + 1
Next kb
Application.Run "Unbind_ALR_Hotkeys"
Application.CustomizationContext = d.AttachedTemplate
unbound = Application.KeyBindings.Count
For Each kb In Application.KeyBindings
If kb.KeyCode = qqc Or kb.KeyCode = rjc Then foundAfterUnbind = foundAfterUnbind + 1
Next kb
Evaluate = Array(foundAfterBind, foundAfterUnbind, bound - unbound)

Dim d As Document, kb As KeyBinding, found As Long, qqc As Long, rjc As Long
Set d = ActiveDocument
qqc = BuildKeyCode(wdKeyControl, wdKeyShift, wdKeyQ)
rjc = BuildKeyCode(wdKeyControl, wdKeyShift, wdKeyX)
Application.Run "Bind_ALR_Hotkeys"
Application.CustomizationContext = d.AttachedTemplate
For Each kb In Application.KeyBindings
If kb.KeyCode = qqc Or kb.KeyCode = rjc Then found = found + 1
Next kb
Application.Run "Unbind_ALR_Hotkeys"
Evaluate = found
